Profile 78 6

Senior .NET Full Stack Developer with 10+ years of experience in designing, developing, and deploying enterprise-scale applications using C#, ASP.NET Core, .NET, Azure Cloud, Angular, Microservices, SQL Server, Power Apps, Power BI, Microsoft Power Automate, SharePoint, Docker, and Kubernetes leveraging AI- powered development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor AI, ChatGPT, Claude AI, and OpenAI APIs to improve code quality, accelerate development, generate unit tests, and enhance productivity. Strong understanding of SOLID principles, Design Patterns, Agile/Scrum methodologies, Test-Driven Development (TDD), and the complete Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC). Experienced in collaborating with cross-functional teams, product owners, business stakeholders, and global teams to deliver innovative, reliable, and customer-centric solutions that improve operational efficiency, system performance, and business growth.
